newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos workers receive rest of April salary.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos workers receive rest of April salary.

text.p: CODESP port authority at Brazil's key port of Santos has deposited outstanding April salaries, removing any need for further industrial action, a union official said.
"There is no further problem," said Francisco Luiz Bertozzi, vice-president of the Administrative Portworkers' Union.

Workers refused to work at public terminals on May 8 in protest at receiving only 65 percent of last month's salary. The delay, CODESP said, was due to a cash-flow problem caused by a four-day stevedores strike in April.
The port authority then deposited the remaining 35 percent of basic salaries but could only pay part of additional performance-related monies which 30 percent of the workforce normally receive.
After prolonged negotiations, union members agreed to wait until today to receive the rest.
A CODESP spokesman said the money had been deposited in the bank yesterday and was available for withdrawal as of this morning.
Santos is Brazil's largest coffee exporting port and also handles sugar, wheat, orange juice and soy products. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
